text: Settle into a comfortable position and allow your body to be supported.
Bring your attention to the top of your head, a gentle warmth begins to move down and through
Your body.
Allow this warmth to move slowly into the forehead.
The temples.
The muscles around the eyes soften.
The space behind the eyes feels spacious and calm.
This warmth flows into the cheeks.
The jaw loosens.
The tongue rests easily in the mouth.
Feel a gentle ease moving through the face, smooth, unrushed.
Allow attention to move into the neck and throat, a sense of openness here, the muscles
Releasing into comfort.
This warmth gently moves down into your shoulders like a gentle and loving massage across the
Collarbones, spreading through the upper chest, arms feel heavier,
Supported.
This warmth continues down through the upper arms.
Elbows, forearms, wrists,
Hands relax.
Chairs rest with ease.
Feel the warmth moving into the chest.
Death flowing gently here, an easy expansion, a quiet settling.
A tension moves into the upper back, across the shoulder blades.
Down, along the spine
The middle of your back releases any tension.
From beneath.
Earth spreads into the lower back.
Muscles hear ease.
The body settles more fully.
Allow awareness to move into the stomach, a sense of softness.
A gentle release.
Death moves easily through this space.
Calm.
Steady.
Feeling continues into the hips and pelvis, a deep grounding here, a feeling of being
Held.
Depth flows down through the thighs.
Knees Calves
Feel the ankles feel heavy, resting.
Feel the ankles soften.
The tops of the feet.
The souls.
All the way down to the tips of your toes.
Your whole body is now warm.
Present.
This rests within the body as a connected field of sensation.
Unified.
Grounded.
At ease, breath flows naturally through this field.
Each inhale refreshing.
Reach, exhale, deepening comfort.
That warmth and ease continue to spread.
Gradually include the sense of space around your body.
The room.
The air.
Your awareness remains fully embodied as it widens gently.
Take a slow breath in, feel the warmth and weight of the body.
As you exhale, allow this sense of comfort to settle even more deeply.
When you feel ready, allow your attention to return naturally to your surroundings.
Carry this warmth and embodied ease with you, grounded,
Present Relaxed
